{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
print(df.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values for sex
print('\nUnique values for sex:', df['sex'].unique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
print('\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline:', df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())
print('Sentinel values in biomarker_final:', df['biomarker_final'].unique())

# Check if 'responded' is binary
print('\nValue counts for responded:', df['responded'].value_counts())"}
